about.body:
A Touch Of Light is a work of fiction. Any mentions or references to real events, people, and places are used fictitiously or altered for narrative purposes. Any other resemblance to reality is purely coincidental.

This game is currently in development. Therefore, the story, visuals, and game elements are subject to change at any time.
